authority: Procedure and construction evidence only; no source acceptance, N0 approval, private gradients, personality qualification or FBM transfer.
goal: Measure whether the personality-specific first-party readout learns useful semantics while preserving original model weights.
procedure: Run under the owner account; preserve complete original token banks across all 49 actual states; train on deterministic human-annotated TRAIN only; evaluate original DEV pools and sentence-unseen DEV separately; compare fixed and untrained controls; exercise exact optimizer/RNG resume, candidate permutation and export/reload; independently verify actual result bytes and canonical receipt.
constraints: No publisher weight edits or gradients
No private identity or FINAL input
No fixture or hash success promoted to behavior qualification
Full Alice/Fable v1 remains the target
decision_criteria: Separate optimization mechanics from useful fit and transfer
Compare learned choices against inexpensive semantic control
Diagnose source dependence and target familiarity before larger architectures or more publisher forwards
Report residual inherited influence without requiring complete erasure
validation: 152 genuine complete feature banks, 2,790,036,480 logical bytes. Exact optimizer/RNG resume and export/reload. Learned TRAIN9/56, DEV1/16 and sentence-unseenDEV1/14; fixed semantic control15/56,4/16,3/14. Learned cross entropy improved relative to untrained architecture, but top-choice accuracy trails the fixed control. No N0 approval or trained Alice identity.
failure_or_lesson: A successful scientific run can produce a weak learned model. Reuse preserved source-bound features to distinguish poor fit, source-independent description shortcuts and held-out transfer before changing architecture or spending more model compute. Zero helper-prefix flips on mostly wrong predictions cannot establish personality neutrality.
